data.reason: The source states that exactly 190 generators arrived on 18 September 2025, whereas the post claims 240 generators were received on that date.

evidence.quote: The final Westmere delivery register states: exactly 190 generators arrived on 18 September 2025. There were no other deliveries that day.
evidence.reason: The delivery register is an official record directly stating the number of generators received, contradicting the claim of 240.
evidence.title: Synthetic Westmere record

claims.explanation: The source S1 is a delivery register that directly records the number of generators received by Westmere on 18 September 2025 as exactly 190, with no other deliveries that day. This directly contradicts the claim that 240 generators were received on that date.
claims.missing: No evidence supports the claim of 240 generators; the exact number delivered is recorded as 190.
